from qiskit import QuantumCircuit


def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # H Z H = X  up to global phase
    # H|0> = |+>, Z|+> = |->, H|-> = |1>
    qc.h(0)
    qc.z(0)
    qc.h(0)

    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
import math


def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # Rx(pi) |0> = -i |1>  -> |1> up to a global phase
    qc.rx(math.pi, 0)

    return qc
